mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document (id, knowledge_base_id, user_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, char_count, chunk_count, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{userId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{charCount}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET char_count = #{charCount}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, user_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, char_count, chunk_count, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, user_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, char_count, chunk_count, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
